history.title: History of Tanza

founded.title: Founded as a Mission Town
founded.text: Tanza was established as a mission town by Augustinian missionaries in 1760, making it one of the oldest settlements in Cavite.

revolution.title: Philippine Revolution
revolution.text: Tanza played a role in the Philippine Revolution against Spanish colonial rule, contributing fighters and resources to the Katipunan movement.

independence.title: Philippine Independence
independence.text: Following the declaration of Philippine independence in 1898, Tanza became part of the newly established Philippine Republic.

renamed.title: American Era Reorganization
renamed.text: During the American colonial period, Tanza was reorganized as a municipality within the Province of Cavite.

growth.title: Post-War Growth
growth.text: Tanza experienced significant population and economic growth in the post-war era, driven by agriculture and coastal fishing industries.

cityhood.title: Modern Development
cityhood.text: The municipality saw rapid urbanization and industrial growth, transforming into one of Cavite's important economic centers.

recognition.title: Thriving Community
recognition.text: Today, Tanza is a thriving municipality with a population of over 339,000 residents across 41 barangays, continuing to grow as part of the CALABARZON region.

history.charteredDesc: Established in 1760, Tanza is one of the oldest municipalities in Cavite with a rich history spanning over 260 years.
history.populationDesc: One of Cavite's fastest-growing municipalities with 41 barangays and a growing economy.
